test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct Speech. They said that they were enjoying the trip.

options.text: They said, "We were enjoying the trip."
They said, "We have enjoyed the trip."
They said, "We are enjoying the trip.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** They said that they were enjoying the trip.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"They said that they were enjoying" becomes "They said, 'We are enjoying'"**
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" is unchanged in the tr
